modules.title: The Madeleine
modules.description: The most famous passage in all of Proust - where memory begins
modules.context: This passage introduces Proust's concept of involuntary memory - how a simple taste can unlock an entire world of forgotten experiences.
questions: What memories are triggered by specific tastes or smells in your life?
How does Proust describe the moment of remembering?

modules.title: Bedtime Drama
modules.description: Young Marcel's anxiety about his mother's goodnight kiss
modules.context: This scene establishes the narrator's sensitive nature and the profound importance of maternal love in shaping his character.
questions: What childhood rituals were important to you?
How does Proust capture the intensity of a child's emotions?

modules.title: The Church at Combray
modules.description: Architecture as a vessel for time and memory
modules.context: Proust uses the church to explore how physical spaces contain layers of historical time.

memory_explorer.title: Memory & Time Explorer
memory_explorer.description: Deep dive into Proust's revolutionary treatment of memory and temporal experience

modules.title: Two Types of Memory
modules.synthesis: Compare how voluntary effort fails where involuntary sensation succeeds in recovering the past.
